test_BACKPROPAGATION_SensitivityAlgorith: test the backpropagation.SensitivityAlgorithm class to propagate output sensitivities through an identity network

test_BACKPROPAGATION_affine_network: test the backpropagation.SensitivityAlgorithm with affine transformations applying weight transpose to sensitivities
test_BOUND_PROPAGATION_bound_propagation: test the bound_propagation.bound_propagation function running sensitivity computation over a logits function
test_INTERVALBOUND_input_bounds: test the jax_verify.IntervalBound class defining lower and upper bounds for neural network inputs
